annotations.text:
Two marks, two jobs.
Invisible: forensic, a serial per licence, sealed on activation after the creator confirms. A missing mark proves nothing, and it does not survive reframing.
Visible: this board, on previews only. It advertises the shop and deters use. Removal tools make it deterrence, not protection.

What the tool always adds on public previews: the PREVIEW label and the link. A creator's logo, or a whole board image of their own, sits beside them and cannot replace them. The sponsor-only preview carries the label and no public link.
Nothing in the pixels that goes stale. No price on the board, since prices change. The link goes to the creator's own domain: no project server counts the clicks, and it has to outlive any host.
Who sees which board. The public shop lists moments with no sponsor in them. A sponsored moment goes only to its sponsor, on the private board, with the delivery report.
Sample values: [SPONSOR], @kernowbuilds and kernow.build. The QR is a placeholder, not a code that scans.
